title: OKF Base Entity Schema
description: Universal frontmatter schema for all Open Knowledge Format entities. This is a LOCAL PRODUCER PROFILE: it is stricter than OKF v0.2, which requires only a parseable frontmatter block carrying a non-empty `type` (spec section 11). A consumer MUST NOT reject a bundle for failing this schema.

id.description: Local extension. OKF identity is the bundle-relative path minus .md (spec section 2); this key must equal that path.

schema.description: Local extension. Canonical schema identifier or relative path. OKF has no schema registry (spec preamble).

okf_version.description: Targeted OKF version. Permitted in a bundle-root index.md only (spec section 12).

type.description: The only always-required OKF key (spec section 4.1). Values are not centrally registered.

title.description: Descriptive human-readable title. Recommended by spec section 4.1.

description.description: Synopsis of the concept. Recommended by spec section 4.1.

resource.description: URI identifying the underlying asset. Absent for concepts describing abstract ideas (spec section 4.1).

tags.description: Search keywords. Recommended by spec section 4.1.

freshness.description: Local extension overlapping generated.at (spec section 5.2). NOT stale_after, which is a future expiry instant.

stale_after.description: A concept is stale when now >= stale_after (spec section 5.5). An absolute instant, not a relative TTL.

status.description: OKF defines draft|stable|deprecated (spec section 5.4); absent means stable. The remaining four are local extensions a generic consumer treats as unknown.

id.description: Optional; SHOULD be present when the body cites the source via a footnote (spec section 5.1).

resource.description: REQUIRED within an entry (spec section 5.1). A followable artifact, or a population/scope descriptor.

type.description: Local extension; not an OKF sources key.

sha256.description: Local extension. Hex SHA-256 of the source at migration time; okf_verify's drift tier reports when the live file no longer matches.

sources.description: Provenance signals, not a verdict (spec section 5.1).

generated.description: generated.by is REQUIRED within generated (spec section 5.2).

verified.description: A list of {by, at} events. A bare mapping MUST be treated as a one-element list (spec section 5.2).

relations.description: Local extension. OKF carries relationships as markdown links only (spec section 6.1), so a generic consumer will not see these edges unless the body also links.
